top_signals.title: Saudis Tell Asian Refiners They Can Soon Pick Up Oil From Yanbu
top_signals.summary: Several Asian refiners have been told informally by Saudi Aramco they will soon be able to pick up oil from the Red Sea port of Yanbu, according to traders familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: UK government borrowing surged to £18bn in August
top_signals.summary: Higher-than-expected figure comes as inflation drives up government spending
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Blow to Healey as government borrowing overshoots by billions
top_signals.summary: Chancellor John Healey has missed key targets on government borrowing ahead of his inaugural Budget after the UK borrowed more than economists forecast in August. The Office for National Statistics (ONS) said borrowing in August was £18.3bn, which was about £3.5bn above a prediction by the Office for Budget Responsibility and overshot market predictions.
